# How We Speak (tryhowwespeak.com)

> Clinical, psychology-backed relationship scripts and nervous system regulation frameworks for couples.

## Core Methodologies
- The 20-Minute De-escalation Protocol
- Nervous System Flooding Regulation
- Scripted Emotional Translation (What You Say vs. What They Hear)

## Guides & Direct Resources
- [The Men's Edition](https://tryhowwespeak.com/men-edition): Decoding male withdrawal, stonewalling, and reactive silence.
- [The Women's Edition](https://tryhowwespeak.com/women-edition): De-escalating hyper-activation, anxiety-driven bids, and emotional overwhelm.
- [Communication Diagnostic Quiz](https://tryhowwespeak.com/quiz): 2-minute assessment evaluating personal conflict reaction profiles.
- [Articles Hub](https://tryhowwespeak.com/articles): Research-backed breakdowns on relational communication dynamics.
